scope: Reproduction gate only; A1-A4 implementation and A3/A4 causal diagnosis have not started.

definitions.teamAggregation: Average each team metric over four corrected normal-rotation seeds before cross-team calculations.
definitions.regression: Simulated metric regressed on observed metric, with intercept. Wins per net point regress wins on own net points.
definitions.residual: Game margin minus home team season PPG net minus away team season PPG net; fitted-season description, not held-out strength.
definitions.gameThresholds: Absolute final margin <=5 or >=20, including overtime.
definitions.ratings: Paired FGA-OREB+TOV+0.44FTA proxy; compare pooled league ratios separately from mean of team ratios.

discrepancies.explanation: 13.07073 occurs at seeds 20261012 and 20261015. Four-seed average is 13.04299.
Pooled counts give 115.15599 versus 112.72815; unweighted mean of team ratings gives 115.14025 versus 112.75040. Neither reproduces the stated pair at two decimals.
